description: This Java class 'CustomAuditingHandler' extends Spring Data's 'AuditingHandler' to customize auditing behavior, including handling of date/time providers based on entity type, and provides methods to mark entities as created or modified with custom logic.

classes.name: CustomAuditingHandler
classes.description: A custom auditing handler extending Spring Data's 'AuditingHandler' to provide entity-specific date/time handling and auditing methods.

methods.name: CustomAuditingHandler
methods.description: Deprecated constructor initializing with MappingContext and AuditorAware.

methods.name: fetchDateTimeProvider
methods.description: Returns a DateTimeProvider based on whether the entity is an instance of AbstractAuditableWithUTCDateTimeCustom.

methods.name: markCreated
methods.description: Marks an entity as created, setting the appropriate DateTimeProvider.

methods.name: markModified
methods.description: Marks an entity as modified, setting the appropriate DateTimeProvider.
